title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: In this task, you are to write an essay on the importance o f developing a healthy lifestyle among college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A healthy lifestyle plays a vital role in the life of every college student. As campus life grows busier with assignments and screens, I firmly believe that keeping fit, eating well and sleeping regularly is not a trivial habit but the very foundation of a successful university experience. For one thing, a sound body directly boosts learning efficiency. A student who stays up all night rushing a due date and lives on takeout will struggle to concentrate the next morning, while regular exercise and balanced meals keep the mind sharp in class. For another, a healthy routine stabilizes our emotions. Sitting still for hours breeds anxiety, whereas a short run often washes away the pressure of exams and eases loneliness far from home. In conclusion, a healthy lifestyle is not optional but essential for college students. The sooner we build it, the more energy and confidence we will carry into our studies and future lives.
keyPoints: 观点前置立中心。首句 A healthy lifestyle plays a vital role 直接落实「亮明重要性观点」句 架，观点前置；第二句用 not a trivial habit but the very foundation 抬高立场，完成 outline 的「开 门见山亮立场」功能。
两理由各配场景。用 For one thing / For another 领起效率与情绪两个分论点，各配 stays up all night rushing a due date、lives on takeout、Sitting still for hours 等大学生场景，并用 while / whereas 做对比，落实「理由加场景例证」，论证不空。
重申加升华收束。In conclusion 换词重申 not optional but essential，再用 The sooner we build it, the more ... 升华成呼吁，落实「重申升华呼吁」功能，结尾不烂尾。
